title: Contractor's Claims
text: If the Contractor considers himself entitled to additional payment, the Contractor shall give notice to the Engineer not later than 28 days after he became aware of the event. If the Contractor fails to give notice within such period of 28 days, the Contractor shall not be entitled to additional payment.

title: Extension of Time for Completion
text: The Contractor shall be entitled subject to Sub-Clause 20.1 to an extension of the Time for Completion if completion is delayed by a Variation or by any delay caused by the Employer.

title: Delay Damages
text: If the Contractor fails to comply with the Time for Completion, the Contractor shall pay delay damages of 0.05% of the Contract Price per day, subject to a maximum of 10%.

title: Payment
text: The Employer shall pay the amount certified in each Interim Payment Certificate within 56 days after the Engineer receives the Statement.

title: Retention
text: Retention Money of ten per cent (10%) shall be deducted from each interim payment until it reaches 5% of the Contract Price.

title: Right to Vary
text: Variations may be initiated by the Engineer by an instruction. A Variation may include additional work and changes to quantities. The Contractor shall be entitled to have each Variation valued.

title: Adjustments for Changes in Cost
text: The Contract Price shall not be adjusted for rises or falls in the cost of labour, materials or other inputs, which are deemed to be included in the Accepted Contract Amount.

title: Unforeseeable Physical Conditions
text: If the Contractor encounters unforeseeable physical conditions he shall give notice to the Engineer within fourteen (14) working days and shall be entitled to an extension of time and payment of Cost.

title: Suspension of Work
text: The Engineer may instruct the Contractor to suspend progress of the Works. The Contractor shall notify the Engineer within 7 days of any Cost incurred.

title: Arbitration
text: Any dispute shall be finally settled by arbitration in Cairo under the CRCICA Rules.

title: Possession of the Site
text: The Employer shall give the Contractor access to and possession of the Site within the time stated. If the Employer fails to give possession, the Contractor shall be entitled to an extension of time.

title: المطالبات
text: يلتزم المقاول بإخطار المهندس كتابياً بأي مطالبة خلال ثمانية وعشرين (28) يوماً من تاريخ علمه بالحدث، وإلا يسقط حقه في المطالبة.

title: مد مدة التنفيذ
text: يحق للمقاول المطالبة بمد مدة التنفيذ في حالة تأخر صاحب العمل في تسليم الموقع أو اعتماد الرسومات.

title: غرامة التأخير
text: في حالة تأخر المقاول عن إنهاء الأعمال توقع عليه غرامة تأخير بنسبة 1 في الألف من قيمة العقد عن كل يوم تأخير بحد أقصى 10%.

title: المستخلصات
text: يلتزم صاحب العمل بصرف قيمة المستخلص المعتمد خلال ٤٥ يوماً من تاريخ اعتماده من المهندس.

title: الأعمال الإضافية
text: لا يجوز للمقاول تنفيذ أية أعمال إضافية إلا بأمر تغيير كتابي، وتحاسب الأعمال الإضافية بفئات جدول الكميات.

title: المحتجزات
text: يستقطع صاحب العمل نسبة 5% من قيمة كل مستخلص كمحتجزات تُرد بعد الاستلام النهائي.

title: الظروف غير المنظورة
text: إذا واجه المقاول ظروفاً طبيعية غير منظورة يلتزم بإخطار المهندس خلال ٧ أيام عمل.

title: فروق الأسعار
text: لا يستحق المقاول أي فروق أسعار عن تغير أسعار المواد أو العمالة طوال مدة العقد.
